name: Russia–NATO
summary: Drones from Belarus crossed Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia on 10–11 Nov; NATO jets failed to down one; no Article 4
state: Overnight on 10–11 Nov drones entering from Belarus triggered air-raid alerts in Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia; NATO fighters twice failed to shoot one down over Lithuania before it flew on through Latvia and Estonia into Russia (Euronews; Reuters via Daily Maverick). Officials said the drone type and origin were not confirmed, and no injuries were reported. No Article 4 request, direct clash or attack on NATO territory was found as of 11 Nov.
for_you: Residents of the Baltic states may see short-notice shelter alerts; follow national civil protection instructions. Travellers can check FCDO travel advice for Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia.
rubric_hit: Airspace/drone violations (Baltic states, 10–11 Nov) = Watch; no Article 4 or direct clash

sources.title: Euronews — 'A restless and difficult night' in the Baltics as NATO fighter jets fail to shoot down drone

why: Direct Russia–NATO confrontation is the most likely path to a European war involving the UK.
drivers: Airspace and drone incursions, sabotage, Baltic incidents, nuclear signalling, Ukraine war spillover.
